name: DayDeal.ch (BRACK/Competec)
geographic_relevance: national CH (ships from BRACK Willisau); online only
data_available: 7 live deals: Tagesdeal (24h) + 6 category 'Wochendeals' (7 days each: IT & Multimedia, Haushalt & Wohnen, Supermarkt & Drogerie, Familie & Baby, Baumarkt & Hobby, Sport & Freizeit). Per deal: title, subtitle (model), specialPrice, originalPrice, calculatedDiscount, comparison basis text, start/end ISO timestamps, BRACK SKU + pdpUrl, images, variants with per-variant price/stock, availability % remaining, sold-out flag.

endpoints.note: Public endpoint called anonymously by daydeal.ch SPA (config url.api.broadcast). robots.txt of broadcast.daydeal.ch explicitly 'Allow: /get_latest_data'.
Same data embedded as window.__REACT_QUERY_STATE__ (queryKey ['activeDeals','de']) – fallback.

robots.deal.daydeal.ch: Disallow: / -> /api/ui/deal/past (past deals) and /deal/by/category_slug NOT allowed, not used

constraints: Same response for honest UA and browser UA (no bot protection observed). Response 159 KB JSON list of 2 events: deals_update (full deals) and availability_update (stock %).
publication_frequency: Tagesdeal: new every day at 09:00 Europe/Zurich (observed startDate 2026-10-13T09:00+02:00, endDate 2026-10-14T09:00+02:00; site meta: 'täglich ab 9:00 Uhr'). Category deals: 7-day runs starting 09:00 on staggered days.
offer_duration: Tagesdeal 24h (09:00-09:00); category deals 7 days; ends early when sold out
stock_published: yes: availability.availablePercentage (0-100) + isSoldOut + buyable; variants[].items[].stock absolute units
pagination: none (single request returns all live deals)
ids_available: deal id, BRACK sku (product id at brack.ch, pdpUrl), navisionId; no EAN in payload (EAN obtainable from BRACK listing data via SKU)

price_fields.reference_meaning: field 'comparison' e.g. 'Self-comparison Brack.ch' = BRACK's own regular price

shipping_cost_info: not in payload (deliveryInformation null in sample)
status_reason: Public, robots-allowed JSON endpoint; tested parser on live response (7 deals, 100% price+reference).
recommended_poll: every 15 min (stock %), plus forced poll at 09:01 Europe/Zurich

parser_spec.steps: payload=json list; deals = event 'deals_update'.payload; availability = event 'availability_update'.payload keyed by id
parser_spec.title: deal.title + ' ' + deal.subtitle
parser_spec.variants: deal.variants[].items[] -> name, specialPrice, originalPrice, calculatedDiscount, stock

notes: DayDeal is BRACK's daily-deal brand; daydeal 'Deal der Woche' = category deals (7-day). BRACK /sale page also embeds daydealBanners JSON with start/end.

name: QoQa.ch
geographic_relevance: national CH (Romandie-based, DE site); some 'Experience' offers are Romandie-local (url_de null)
data_available: All live offers (33 at test time) across universes (Tech & Co., Sport, Mode, Wohnen, Wein & Spirituosen, Küche, Uhren, Experience...). List: id, name, universe, sub_universes, price_range_min/max, started_at, ends_at, remaining_stock_percent, discount label, urls. Detail: products[].variants[] with price, regular_price, stock_status, content_markdown (incl. 'Spätestes Versanddatum').

endpoints.note: documented OpenAPI 3 spec; discovered via https://www.qoqa.ch/.well-known/ard.json (linked as 'Agentmap' in robots.txt). Described by QoQa as 'Public REST API built only for AI agents, ... no key needed'. MCP server https://mcp.qoqa.ch also listed.

constraints: No images and no brand/EAN fields in agent API. Price list level only gives ranges; reference price only in detail (regular_price).
publication_frequency: Offers start at 10:00, 12:00 or 20:00 Europe/Zurich (observed started_at values); multiple per day per universe
offer_duration: mostly 24-48h; wine offers up to ~6 days; ends_at = start + N days + 15 min (e.g. 12:00 -> 12:15)
pagination: none; list returns all live offers ('count')
ids_available: offer id, public_identifier UUID, product id, variant UUID; no EAN

price_fields.reference_meaning: QoQa 'regular price' (basis not specified in API)
price_fields.discount: list 'discount' label e.g. '-25%' / 'Bis zu -71%' (null for many)

shipping_cost_info: not in API; content_markdown mentions latest shipping date only
images: not in agent API (only on HTML offer page)
status_reason: Documented, keyless, robots-allowed JSON API; tested list (33 offers) + detail (3 variants).
alternative: MCP server https://mcp.qoqa.ch (same data); HTML offer pages for images
recommended_poll: list every 30 min + at 10:01/12:01/20:01; detail once per new offer id

parser_spec.title: offers[].name (brand is first word(s) but not separate)
parser_spec.discount: parse int from offers[].discount ('-25%'); or compute 1-price/regular_price

notes: QoQa sister brands (Qwine, Qsport, Qooking...) appear as universes in the same feed.
